source.dataset: Trail-based plant community monitoring in Azorean native forests (Terceira & São Miguel, 2017–2019)
source.note: Historical versions disagree on Event rows 260 vs 210; latest v1.4 counts must NOT be inferred or coerced from an earlier version.

why_separate: A different 2017–2019 plant survey lineage on two islands; no reuse of the closed 2013 MOVECLIM focal-plot response or ForestEco2 plant records. Even if eligible it would be an exploratory cross-island habitat-filter test, not replication of historical loss taxa automatically.

published_design.nested_hierarchy: year > island/trail > area along trail > physical 2x10m plot > transect line > 10 plant-cover points; 260 or 210 events are line observations, not independent whole forest plots
published_design.eventid_granularity: year.trail_name.sampling_area.plot.line, trail_name itself may contain periods and must be joined from middle tokens

response_blind_only: Download exact v1.4 source archive one time under strict 1MB cap
Read ZIP central directory filenames/sizes/checksums and Darwin Core meta.xml field terms, indices and rowType only
Do not read Event file, Occurrence file, species names, nativeness values or site/location labels
Output archive SHA256 and schema roles; never infer ecological effect or dataset independence by number of Event rows alone
qualified_only_if: Exactly one Event core with an explicit id index and one Occurrence extension with coreid index
Event metadata has eventID, island or locality and year/eventDate, or eventID with documented grammar
Occurrence metadata contains scientificName and establishmentMeans; if native status missing, stop any native/alien-score eligibility
Original archive has no unsafe paths, malformed XML or semantic access to biological data
next_gate: Source-only Event value inspection following separate v1.292 freeze: enumerate complete trail×year×area×plot×line universe and balanced edge-versus-interior supports per trail, 0 occurrence rows opened. Never open species-level records until hierarchies and island/trail denominators explicitly fixed.
unscorable_conditions: Event response association or nativeness statuses missing
No matched edge/interior plot groups within >=2 independently sampled trails
Only one usable island or all alien taxa absent
Source version mismatch or unexplained source role changes
statistical_goal_future: Within-trail matched edge vs interior native-and-alien compositional contrast with trail as independent replication, not 260 pseudoreplicated line records; no claim of experimental trampling causation unless event codes identify actual randomized intervention.
prior_work: Publisher metadata itself describes trail disturbance and invasion-monitoring purpose; simple trail effects would be expected, not necessarily newly discovered mechanism. Study question is a contrast in relative native/alien composition after specifying nested sampling effort.
